findings.summary: __attrs_post_init__ pushes a scope even when id_of(schema) returns None (no $id or boolean schema), putting None on the resolver scope stack, which can break or misdirect urljoin in resolve/resolving; needs a None guard.

The scope stack grows on every descend/evolve because pushed scopes are never popped (only _validate_reference pops), leaving stale base URIs so refs in sibling subschemas may resolve against the wrong base.
The new test only covers a single root-level $ref and does not exercise nested subschemas without $id; a test for that should be added.
Three blank lines before def sorted_errors where two are expected, which flake8 reports as E303.
